title:
The garden,
in three dimensions.
subtitle: 3D / THE GARDEN MODEL
body: A model study connects the water court, dining pavilion, circular lounge and productive beds. Simplified planting masses describe enclosure; the masterplan remains the guide to conceptual zoning.

title:
A clear frame
for still water.
subtitle: 3D / WATER COURT STUDY
body: Pale steps, a dark timber canopy and a reflecting basin give the garden its structure. A deliberately simple shaded model explores the relationship between these elements.

title:
The first marks
of a quiet place.
subtitle: CRAYON / WATER COURT SKETCH
body: Loose crayon strokes explore the balance of still water, dark shelter and generous planting. Paper grain and unfinished edges preserve the feeling of an early design conversation.

title:
Follow the
softer line.
subtitle: CRAYON / MEADOW WALK SKETCH
body: A winding gravel path, violet flowers and an oak bench beneath birches. A handdrawn-style study in olive, ochre and lavender, exploring movement and seasonal texture.
